name: Global commission rate
note: The percentage the platform keeps on every booking, and whether it differs for tours, homestays and transport. Nobody has set a starting rate yet, so every finance figure below counts commission at nothing.

name: Manual or instant confirmation
note: Which products a supplier must confirm by hand and which confirm instantly with a QR code — set per product or per supplier.

name: Default cancellation window
note: The refund window that applies before a supplier sets a policy of their own.

name: Largest party a 15-minute hold covers
note: Whether the checkout hold has a ceiling on party size, or holds seat by seat for a 45-person coach.

name: Departure scope
note: Whether the platform sells travel inside Nghệ An only, or also inbound packages leaving Hà Nội and HCM.
